scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind worksheet calculations.
Equal sign: begins a spreadsheet formula. SUM: adds numbers in a selected range.
AVERAGE: calculates the arithmetic mean. MAX: finds the largest number. MIN: finds the smallest number.
Collect a few harmless facts about classroom materials, NOT personal details. Make a paper chart with the terms Equal sign, SUM and AVERAGE; explain what each means.
